newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Unilabs clinical labs group to go public.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Unilabs clinical labs group to go public.

text.p: Unilabs SA, a Geneva-based clinical laboratory group active in Switzerland and Europe, said it would go public with subscription starting April 16 and trading on the Swiss bourse set for April 25.
Unilabs had sales of about 115 million Swiss francs and net profit of 6.6 million in the business year that ended May 31, 1996, a company statement said.
It said Union Bank of Switzerland (UBS) would lead manage the offering of 35 percent of Unilab share capital with 28 percent of voting rights.
Insitututional and individual investors would be offered 84,000 of the total 180,000 registered shares, with a face value of 40 Swiss francs, in a price range of 625 to 675 Swiss francs per share.
A reserve of 8,400 shares would be set aside in case the offering was oversubscribed, Unilabs said.
"Going public will create the financial conditions necessary for continuing the successful development of the company in its second decade of existance," Unilabs said.
Unilabs said its workforce numbered 720. It said it was market leader in Switzerland for clinical laboratory testing for human diagnosis and also active in Britain, Spain, Italy, Istanbul and Moscow.
